themes.text: Most reviewers like the small plates, cheese and charcuterie, but a few call the food small-portioned or underwhelming.
quotes: Cheese and meat plate is lovely. The cheeses were really good and 3 different kinds.
Ok place for a drink. Food is underwhelming.

themes.label: Cozy atmosphere and patio
themes.text: The warm, cozy room and the back patio or yard are often praised, with one complaint that it was dark and hot.
quotes: Brilliant cocktails in a warm, inviting atmosphere. The backyard is wonderful when the weather cooperates.
Great cocktails but when I went it was super dark and really hot inside

themes.label: Date-night spot
themes.text: Reviewers often recommend it for dates or a pre- or post-dinner drink.
quotes: My go-to spot for a pre or post dinner drink. Always good on date night.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious, fresh and well cooked, though a few found it just okay, too salty or poorly prepared.
quotes: The food here was delicious. Beautiful decor. Great, quick service. Will definitely be coming back here!!
Service was great but the food was just okay.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Service is mostly described as friendly, polite and fast, with a few complaints about slow service, short staffing or rude cooks.
quotes: every single time I had exceptional service. The staff are all very nice and pleasant.
Slow service; but expensive for what it is.

themes.label: Hibachi chef show
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy watching the food cooked at the table and the entertaining chefs, though one wanted more interaction and others had cooking mistakes.
quotes: our chef was the funniest..very entertaining..food was very good!
I expected interaction with the chef

themes.label: Prices and tipping
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable and portions generous, while others call it pricey or object to automatic gratuity and billing.
quotes: Hibachi is an enjoyable experience. Food is good and the prices are very reasonable
They include gratuity on their checks with parties of 4 there are no signs in the menu or wall

themes.label: Space and cleanliness
themes.text: Reviewers describe the restaurant as small or cramped, with a cold upstairs and some concerns about sanitation.
quotes: due to their very chilly and frigid upstairs dining area. It was so cold my family and I couldn't enjoy our food
They were not very sanitary. I would be concerned to eat here.
